title: Stampede
description: 4 096 horses gallop around a valley at golden hour. Point at them to spook them, and the panic spreads through the herd. Hover a horse to see its name, click one to ride along, or click the ground for a thunderclap. Nearby horses are skinned meshes and distant ones are impostor cards, and three shadow cascades keep shadows sharp up close while still reaching the trees 320 m out. The horse is by Quaternius (CC0), and the trees and rocks are from Kay Lousberg's KayKit Forest Nature Pack (CC0).
line: 4 096 horses in a golden valley. Spook them and the panic spreads.
hint: point at the herd to spook it · click a horse to ride along · click the ground for thunder · drag to orbit
